subject: A few thoughts
text: As a long-time friend of the family, I wanted to share a few thoughts, partly because I have watched how busy you get around quarter-end. If the repair inspection can wait until after the wedding weekend, I would take that chance. There is already a family commitment on Saturday morning, and traveling across the city that day would feel too rushed. Maybe call the vendor now and ask whether the quote can be held for a week. People are usually reasonable when you explain honestly. Also, do not answer every call immediately; I noticed you sound stressed after those long calls. A short pause often makes the negotiation simpler. Tell them you can confirm the final choice Monday, even if they push for today. You do not want to rush into something you will regret. I know it sounds simple, but your time is valuable, and being firm does not make you rude. Keep the notes on your phone, and if they mention pricing changes, write the date down. That way nothing slips past you.
